# Did a dependency just start running code at install time?

> Paste your package-lock.json and see every package that runs a preinstall, install, postinstall, or prepare script at install time -- and, with an older lockfile, exactly which ones started doing that since your last check. npm audit does not flag this. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
